info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Streaming Subscriptions Devices-v1-spec
info.description: The Streaming Subscriptions Devices API provides access to a comprehensive list of devices associated with streaming subscriptions. This endpoint allows users to retrieve information on various devices that can access subscription-based content streaming. It is particularly useful for developers managing content delivery systems or subscription services, making it easier to understand and optimize device engagement. Typical consumers include product managers, system integrators, and developers working with streaming service platforms.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of devices under subscriptions.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch a comprehensive list of devices that are currently under your subscriptions. Use this to monitor, manage, or analyze the devices associated with your account.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving subscribed devices. This body typically includes filters and parameters to narrow down the list of devices returned in the response.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of devices for the subscription.
